title: ze_tyranny2
description: Five stages of fantasy bosses by Moray and nano (CS2 port by Tenshi): the Spider, the Troll, the Dragon and Rakiora, Gargantua and Diablo's lasers, then Diablo, Angra and Diablo's last lasers.

scenarios.name: Spider (boss)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the spider's poison balls and pools
scenarios.description: Stage 1 (leveltrigger_case 1). You cross s1boss_trigger into the arena: Map_HP_Zone counts the humans 1 s later and each one adds 40 hits to the segment (bosshp2 / bosshp1: 1 + 40 per human), 10 segments (bosshp3). At +22 s the spider rises (s1boss_move) and every 6-11 s (s1boss_atk_timer) lobs 4 poison balls 0.5 s apart from s1boss_atk_maker at one of 48 aims (4 pitches x 12 yaws): a physbox on a phys_thruster (5000) that hurts 100 in flight, then lands and pools for 120 at +5 s. At +52 s s1_spider_hurt_all_trig poisons the whole arena (16 a tick). GFL's BossHUD calls it Snake.

scenarios.name: Troll (boss)
scenarios.description: Stage 2. You drop through s2boss_trigger into the troll's pit: each human adds 30 hits a segment (Map_Hp_Add_Boss_S2), 10 segments. At +10 s the troll spawns on bossmovement_temp: a physbox on five thrusters that chases whoever its spinning bossmove_rotate_trigger tags (context bosstar, 5 s), hurting on touch (s2boss_hurt1). Every s2boss_atk_timer tick it throws 5 rocks (s2_boss_atk_temp) from the rotating s2boss_atk_rot1 / rot2 launcher.

scenarios.name: Dragon (boss)
scenarios.summary: Tornadoes, fire breath, wind and gravity
scenarios.description: Stage 3. Past s3boss_trigger each human adds 38 hits a segment (Map_Hp_Add_Boss_S3), 10 segments. The dragon appears at +15 s; from +25 s s3boss_atkcase picks an attack every 10-13 s: tornadoes (s3_boss_atk_tornado_temp, wandering physboxes that push you), fire breath (s3boss_atk_fire_trigger spawning fire trains), wind (s3boss_atk_wind_hurt) or gravity (s3boss_atk_grav_hurt).

scenarios.name: Rakiora (ending)
scenarios.summary: Shoot the charging sea serpent down
scenarios.description: The stage 3 ending. At s3door_10_3 the humans hold 20 s; s3_snake_template spawns Rakiora and every human in s3_snake_add gives each of its 10 segments 4 hits (Boss_HealthBackup_snake). At +22 s it rises from the river, and at +25 s it charges down s3_snake_path1 -> 3 at 1015 u/s with a 99999 hurt: kill it before it reaches you. Its death (s3_snake_hitbox OnBreak) opens the end: win when s3end_trigger2 takes you.

scenarios.name: Gargantua (boss)
scenarios.summary: A charging giant with barrels and crystals
scenarios.description: Stage 4. Past s4boss_trigger each human adds 48 hits a segment (Map_Hp_Add_Boss_S4), 10 segments; the door behind closes at +10 s. Gargantua spawns at +15 s on the same thruster mover as the troll (bossmovement_temp) and chases its tagged human, burning on touch (s4boss_hurt1). From +27 s s4boss_atkcase1 picks attacks: barrels, crystals, a gravity cannon, fire and ice.

scenarios.name: Diablo's lasers (ending)
scenarios.summary: Jump or crouch ten fast lasers
scenarios.description: The stage 4 ending. At s4door_13_2 the humans hold; Diablo appears behind them at +10 s and from +11.5 s to +21.4 s fires 10 lasers (s4boss_diablo_case, random height: 24, 44 or 66 u off the floor) up the hall at 3050 u/s, 999999 damage: jump the low ones, crouch the high one. Win when s4end_trigger2 takes you at +26 s.

scenarios.name: Diablo (boss)
scenarios.description: Stage 5. Past s5boss_trigger each human adds 54 hits a segment (Map_Hp_Add_Boss_S5), 10 segments; after the 16 s hold and the cutscene (cutscene_relay -> cutscene_beam_center) Diablo is summoned and chases the human Diablo_Target_Finder tags (Diablo_MovePhys, five thrusters), burning for 150 on touch. Every 7.5-13 s s5boss_atkcase picks: gravity ring, meteors, cannon fire, beams, crystals or tornadoes.

scenarios.name: Angra (boss)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the lanes of venom balls
scenarios.description: After Diablo: the humans hold 40 s at s5door_13_2, then s5boss_angra_trigger brings Angra down (s5boss_angra_move1) and hp_fix gives its 10 segments 15 hits per human. From +6.5 s after it lands, every 1.8 s (s5boss_angra_atk_timer1) it sends two venom balls down two of six lanes (s5boss_angra_atk_case1) at 1280 u/s, 120 damage each.

scenarios.name: Diablo's last lasers (ending)
scenarios.summary: Shoot Diablo while jumping his lasers
scenarios.description: The stage 5 ending. After Angra, s5boss_diablo_trigger gives the last Diablo 10 hits per human per segment and the humans hold at s5door_14_3; Diablo lands at +10 s and from +17 s fires a laser every 1.2 s (s5boss_diablo_case_false: random height 24, 44 or 66 u off the floor, 2400 u/s, 999999 damage) until his 10 segments are gone. Map_Laser_Limit kills everyone in the end zone 120 s after the lasers start. Win when s5end_trigger2 takes you, 6 s after he dies.
